Scalpingový model pro NQ a ES na kostře: A scalping model for NQ and ES on the skeleton of ICT's model 2022: a liquidity grab, a structure shift and an entry into the FVG in the New York morning window. The first backtest on three years of NQ data (115 trades) came out around zero: win rate 52.2 %, profit factor 0.94. Not even the best of 864 parameter variants showed an edge on unseen data.
Vstupy jen po otevření cash seance a běh: Entries only after the cash session opens and during the Silver Bullet window 10:00–11:00. No trading outside the window, everything is closed by 12:00 at the latest.
High a low předchozího dne a overnight h: The previous day's high and low and the overnight high and low (18:00–9:30). Those are the levels where stops lie.
Cena musí jednu z úrovní prorazit. Sweep: Price must break one of the levels. A sweep of highs looks for a short, a sweep of lows for a long. Midnight open filter: shorts only above the midnight opening price, longs only below it.
Svíčka musí zavřít za posledním swingem: A candle must close beyond the last swing against the direction of the sweep and the move must leave an FVG of at least 4 ticks. Within 20 candles of the sweep, otherwise the setup is off.
Limitní příkaz na 50 % FVG (consequent e: A limit order at 50 % of the FVG (consequent encroachment). Valid for 10 candles, then cancelled.
Stop 4 ticky za extrémem sweepu. Když vy: Stop 4 ticks beyond the sweep extreme. When the stop comes out larger than 40 points, the trade is not taken.
Výstup: polovina na 1R, zbytek na 2R: Exit: half at 1R, the rest at 2R
Po dosažení 1R se půlka pozice zavře a s: When 1R is reached, half the position is closed and the stop goes to entry. The rest aims for 2R. At most one trade a day.
Otevření seance a Silver Bullet okno: Session open and the Silver Bullet window

Částečný výběr zvedá winrate, 2R drží př: A partial exit raises the win rate, 2R keeps a reasonable RR
